MIR15A|Chronic lymphocytic leukemia|deleted||Literature association||12434020|Abstract: miR15 and miR16 lie in a 30-kb region of loss at 13q14 and are "deleted or down-regulated" in the majority (approximately 68%) of CLL cases. Recorded as deleted; the abstract does not separate deletion from down-regulation. No case count stated, so cohort left empty.

MIR16-1|Chronic lymphocytic leukemia|deleted||Literature association||12434020|Abstract: miR15 and miR16 lie in a 30-kb region of loss at 13q14 and are "deleted or down-regulated" in the majority (approximately 68%) of CLL cases. Recorded as deleted; the abstract does not separate deletion from down-regulation. No case count stated, so cohort left empty.

HOTAIR|Colorectal cancer|upregulated|liver metastasis; poor prognosis|Literature association|Subset of 32 CRC specimens (PRC2 correlation analysis only)|21862635|Higher in tumour than matched noncancerous tissue; high expression correlated with liver metastasis and relatively poorer prognosis in stage IV CRC. Size of the expression/prognosis cohort not stated in abstract; the 32 specimens are the GSEA subset showing correlation with SUZ12, EZH2, H3K27me3. Erratum 2012.

MALAT1|Non-small cell lung cancer||metastasis; survival (prognostic in stage I)|Literature association|n=70 NSCLC patients|12970751|Published as MALAT-1. Overexpressed in stage I tumours that metastasised vs those that did not; association was stage- and histology-specific. Direction left empty: tumour vs normal tissue not compared in abstract (MALAT-1 also highly expressed in healthy lung).

MALAT1|Lung cancer||metastasis|Experimental functional||23243023|ZFN knockout (1,000-fold silencing) in human lung tumour cells: impaired migration, fewer xenograft nodules; ASOs prevented metastasis. Regulates metastasis-associated gene expression, not splicing; no single gene target named in abstract. Conflict of interest: five authors employed by ISIS Pharmaceuticals.

HULC|Hepatocellular carcinoma|upregulated||Literature association|46 HCCs, 4 focal nodular hyperplasias, 7 cirrhoses (cDNA array screen)|17241883|Most up-regulated gene in HCC in the screen. Detected in blood of HCC patients; authors propose it as a potential biomarker. siRNA knockdown in 2 HCC cell lines altered several genes; none named in abstract.

GAS5|Breast cancer|downregulated||Literature association||18836484|Transcript levels significantly reduced in breast cancer vs adjacent unaffected normal epithelium; sample count not stated. Cell-line work shows GAS5 controls apoptosis and growth; no target named.

PCA3|Prostate cancer|upregulated||Literature association|53 of 56 prostatic tumours vs matched nonneoplastic tissue|10606244|Published as DD3. Prostate-specific: no expression in 18 normal non-prostate tissues or in other tumour types and cell lines sampled. Authors propose it as a diagnostic marker.

MIRLET7A1|Lung cancer|downregulated||Literature association||15766527|let-7 expression lower in lung tumours than normal lung tissue; RAS protein higher in lung tumours. Abstract names the let-7 family; recorded against let-7a-1 as family representative, matching this paper's interaction rows.

MIR34A|Pancreatic cancer|downregulated||Literature association||17540599|Frequently absent in pancreatic cancer cells (cell lines; no tissue cohort in abstract). The abstract's "commonly deleted in human cancers" is background, not this paper's finding, so no deletion row is recorded.
MIR221|Glioblastoma|||Literature association||17627278|High levels in glioblastomas, correlating with low p27(Kip1) protein. Direction left empty: no comparator tissue named in abstract.
MIR222|Glioblastoma|||Literature association||17627278|High levels in glioblastomas, correlating with low p27(Kip1) protein. Direction left empty: no comparator tissue named in abstract.
MIR21|Hepatocellular carcinoma|upregulated||Literature association||17681183|Highly overexpressed in HCC tumours and cell lines (miRNA microarray). Sample count not stated in abstract.

H19|Hepatocellular carcinoma||tumour growth|Experimental functional||17786216|H19 knockdown ablated tumorigenicity in vivo; ectopic H19 enhanced tumorigenic potential. Hypoxia upregulates H19; tumour vs normal not compared in abstract, so direction left empty.

H19|Bladder carcinoma||tumour growth|Experimental functional||17786216|H19 knockdown ablated tumorigenicity in vivo; ectopic H19 enhanced tumorigenic potential. Hypoxia upregulates H19; tumour vs normal not compared in abstract, so direction left empty.

MIR10B|Breast cancer||clinical progression; invasion and metastasis|Literature association||17898713|Level in primary breast carcinomas correlates with clinical progression; highly expressed in metastatic breast cancer cells. Direction left empty: comparison is within cancer, not vs normal. Erratum 2008; published comment and reply 2008.

MIR126|Breast cancer||relapse; poor distal metastasis-free survival|Literature association||18185580|Expression lost in the majority of primary breast tumours from patients who relapse; loss associated with poor distal metastasis-free survival. Direction left empty: comparison is within cancer (relapse vs not), not vs normal. Restoring miR-126 reduced tumour growth in vivo.

MIR335|Breast cancer||relapse; poor distal metastasis-free survival|Literature association||18185580|Expression lost in the majority of primary breast tumours from patients who relapse; loss associated with poor distal metastasis-free survival. Direction left empty: comparison is within cancer (relapse vs not), not vs normal. Abstract reports miR-335-regulated gene set associated with distal metastasis risk in "a large cohort"; no count given.

MIR373|Breast cancer||metastasis|Literature association||18193036|Abstract: "significant upregulation of miR-373 in clinical breast cancer metastasis samples", inversely correlated with CD44. Comparator not named, so direction left empty. Sample count not stated.
MIR9-3|Breast cancer|upregulated||Literature association||20173740|Abstract: miR-9 "upregulated in breast cancer cells". Recorded against the mir-9-3 locus, matching this paper's interaction rows.

MIR9-3|Not specified in abstract||tumour grade; metastatic status|Literature association||20173740|Abstract: "in human cancers, miR-9 levels correlate with MYCN amplification, tumour grade and metastatic status". Tumour types not named in abstract. Recorded against the mir-9-3 locus.

HOTAIR|Breast cancer|upregulated|predicts metastasis and death|Literature association||20393566|Increased in primary breast tumours and metastases; expression level in primary tumours predicts eventual metastasis and death. Comparator tissue and cohort size not stated in abstract.
CDKN2B-AS1|Prostate cancer|upregulated||Literature association||20541999|ANRIL is CDKN2B-AS1. ANRIL (and CBX7) found at elevated levels in prostate cancer tissues. Sample count not stated.
PTENP1|Not specified in abstract|deleted||Literature association||20577206|PTENP1 locus selectively lost in human cancer; tumour types not named in abstract.

PCAT1|Prostate cancer||molecular subtype stratification|Literature association|102 prostate tissues and cell lines (RNA-seq discovery cohort)|21804560|Published as PCAT-1. PCAT-1 and PRC2 expression patterns stratified patient tissues into molecular subtypes; implicated in a subset of prostate cancer patients. Direction not stated in abstract. Cohort count covers the PCAT discovery screen, not PCAT-1 specifically.

SCHLAP1|Prostate cancer|upregulated|independently predicts metastasis and prostate cancer-specific mortality|Literature association||24076601|Published as SChLAP1 (LINC00913). Overexpressed in a subset of prostate cancers. Cohort sizes not stated in abstract.

CCAT1|Colorectal cancer|||Literature association||24662484|Isoform CCAT1-L, "transcribed specifically in human colorectal cancers". Direction left empty: abstract states specificity, not a comparison with normal colon. Erratum 2014.

lncRNA-ATB|Hepatocellular carcinoma||metastasis; poor prognosis|Literature association||24768205|Upregulated in HCC metastases and associated with poor prognosis. Direction left empty: comparison is metastases within cancer, not vs normal. Cohort size not stated.

PVT1|Not specified in abstract|amplified||Literature association||25043044|PVT1 copy number co-increased in more than 98% of MYC-copy-increase cancers; PVT1 RNA correlates with MYC protein in primary tumours. Tumour types not named. 8q24 gain and poor prognosis is background, so not recorded as this paper's finding.

FALEC|Ovarian cancer|amplified|outcome|Literature association|2,394 tumour specimens from 12 cancer types (pan-cancer SCNA survey)|25203321|Published as FAL1 (focally amplified lncRNA on chromosome 1). Copy number and expression correlated with outcomes in ovarian cancer. Ovarian subset size not stated. siRNA inhibited tumour growth in vivo.

NEAT1|Prostate cancer|upregulated|prostate cancer progression|Literature association||25415230|Most significantly overexpressed lncRNA in prostate cancer among putatively ERalpha-regulated lncRNAs; associated with progression in "two large clinical cohorts" (sizes not stated). High-NEAT1 cells recalcitrant to androgen or AR antagonists.

SMIM10L2A|Not specified in abstract|downregulated||Literature association||25813522|LED is SMIM10L2A. Promoter hypermethylation analysis shows silencing of LED in human tumours; tumour types not named.

CDR1-AS|Colorectal cancer|upregulated|poor overall survival|Literature association|Training cohort: 153 primary CRC tissues and 44 matched normal mucosae; validation cohort n = 165|28174233|Published as ciRS-7. Upregulated vs matched normal mucosa (P = 0.0018); overexpression associated with poor survival in both cohorts. Independent risk factor in multivariate analysis reached P = 0.0324 in validation but P = 0.0656 in training.

TMZR1|Glioblastoma|upregulated||Literature association||39889913|TMZR1-eRNA expression markedly lower in healthy brain tissue and PBMC. Knockdown sensitised patient glioblastoma cells with higher eRNA expression to temozolomide (functional; mechanism via STAT3 is in interactions).

MYC-eRNA|Pancreatic cancer|upregulated||Literature association||40216980|Abstract: "a higher amount of MYC eRNA is observed in chronic pancreatitis and in pancreatic cancer patients". Comparator group and sample counts not stated.

CCND1e|Not specified in abstract||cancer susceptibility (predicted)|Computational prediction|28,033 RNA-seq samples from 11,606 individuals; TWAS across 23 cancer types|39950845|Identified as a susceptibility eRNA in a pan-cancer eRNA TWAS; abstract does not say for which cancer type. Functional validation was in prostate cancer cells (see interactions).
